tasks.title: Fix parameter parsing for routes containing regex special characters
tasks.description: When a route has parameters like '/users/:id+' or '/files/:name.ext', the regex compiler fails to escape dots and plus signs, resulting in regex compilation errors. Escape all static path segments before constructing the RegExp.

tasks.title: Implement wildcard catch-all route support (*)
tasks.description: Add support for defining wildcard routes using '*path' or '*' that capture all subsequent segments into a 'wildcard' parameter dictionary.

tasks.title: Normalize trailing slashes in route matching
tasks.description: Requests to '/api/users/' fail to match routes defined as '/api/users'. Implement configurable trailing slash normalization so paths match regardless of trailing slash.

tasks.title: Add sequential middleware pipeline
tasks.description: Implement a `router.use(middleware)` pipeline that executes middleware functions sequentially before the route handler is invoked, supporting `next()` continuation.

tasks.title: Extract URL parser into dedicated path-parser module
tasks.description: The path segment parsing logic in `src/router.ts` is 150 lines long. Extract it cleanly into `src/path-parser.ts` with explicit type exports, maintaining full backward compatibility with existing tests.

tasks.title: Add unit tests for URL query string decoding edge cases
tasks.description: Write comprehensive unit tests in `test/query.test.ts` covering encoded characters, arrays in query strings (`?ids=1&ids=2`), and empty keys.

tasks.title: Fix method handler overwrite on shared path
tasks.description: Registering `router.get('/items', h1)` and `router.post('/items', h2)` currently causes the second registration to overwrite the first method dictionary. Fix handler map indexing.

tasks.title: Implement router.group() for prefix scoping
tasks.description: Add a `group(prefix: string, setup: (subRouter: Router) => void)` method that prefixes all registered sub-routes cleanly.

tasks.title: Support None payload values in transition events
tasks.description: Passing `payload={'user_id': None}` to `machine.trigger()` throws an unhandled `TypeError` inside payload validator. Handle `None` gracefully as a valid payload value.

tasks.title: Add on_enter and on_exit transition lifecycle hooks
tasks.description: Support callback functions attached to states that execute whenever a state is entered or exited during a successful transition.

tasks.title: Raise custom CircularTransitionError on infinite transition loop
tasks.description: When a guard callback triggers another transition creating an infinite cycle, the machine crashes with Python's `RecursionError`. Add a transition depth counter and raise `CircularTransitionError`.

tasks.title: Export state machine definition to Mermaid diagram format
tasks.description: Add a method `machine.to_mermaid() -> str` that generates a valid Mermaid `stateDiagram-v2` string representing all states and transition arrows.

tasks.title: Refactor raw state dict to dataclass StateNode
tasks.description: Refactor internal dictionary structures in `state_flow/machine.py` to use a typed `@dataclass class StateNode`, preserving all public API methods.

tasks.title: Add concurrency tests for transition triggers
tasks.description: Add unit tests in `tests/test_concurrency.py` verifying that simultaneous calls to trigger transitions from multiple threads maintain deterministic state locks.

tasks.title: Clear transition history upon machine reset
tasks.description: Calling `machine.reset()` resets the current state to initial state but fails to clear `machine.history`, leading to invalid audit trails. Ensure history list is reinitialized.
